wiki.title: Myrmidens
wiki.description: Myrmidens is a raucous Human city located on the Black Peninsula at the mouth of the Lagoon of Tears in the southern Border Princes, originally founded by Tilean exiles from Luccini many years ago. It now serves as a marketplace for mercenaries. The city is a sprawling cliffport and one of the most prominent settlements of the Black Peninsula.

wiki.title: Kasos
wiki.description: Kasos, also known as Kásos, is a settlement located in the Border Princes on the Lagoon of Tears. In 2276 IC it was ruled by Baron Oswain Lothar of House Aquilena.

wiki.title: Argalis
wiki.description: Argalis, known in Tilean as Argalide, is a lonely, palisaded settlement located near the brooding Kharnos Forest on the Border Princes ' south-western coast west of the Bay of Wrecks, a densely wooded hinterland that concealed all manner of fell beasts and evil men. The settlement is very old by the standards of the Border Princes.

wiki.title: Khypris
wiki.description: Khypris, also known as Khypria, is the capital of the small Khyprian empire in the Border Princes, which stretches from the Black Mountains along the Tana Dante river, and comprises three provinces: the Northern Lands, the Western Lands, and Central Territory. In addition to Khypris, the Prince also controls various settlements and towns such as Cabanal, Aldium, Alynda, the village of Vimera, and the large town of Mentreba. It is currently governed by Prince Harmis Detz.

wiki.title: Malko
wiki.description: Malko is a fortified city of the Border Princes. It is a large settlement by the standards of the Border Princes, and relatively prosperous. Its prosperity is largely the result of its location in an especially fertile area within the region, so that a few agricultural towns can be found surrounding and feeding the fortified city.

properties.name: Vidovdan
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

wiki.title: Matorea
wiki.description: Matorea, formally the Principality of Matorea, also known as Matorca, is a port city rich in salt located on the Black Gulf in the eastern Border Princes south of the city of Akendorf.

wiki.title: Thessos
wiki.description: Thessos is a settlement of the Border Princes in the northern Black Peninsula. In 2276 IC it was ruled by Baron Oswain Lothar of House Aquilena. Lying on the River Road, Thessos occupies a key junction within the trade network that runs through the Kharnos Forest toward the Dwarf hold of Karak Grom, and the city of Lakoras in the Border Princes, serving as an inland hub where river traffic and caravan routes intersect.

wiki.title: Zvörak
wiki.description: Zvörak, also known as Zvorak, is an ancient walled town of the Border Princes which stands where the Old Dwarf Road from the Apuccini Mountains in the west meets the Old Silk Road to the east. The town bustles with merchants and mercenaries and is renowned for its reserves of marble.

wiki.title: Munzig
wiki.description: Munzig is a walled city on the southern slope of the Black Mountains in the Border Princes. Although it lies on the south side of Black Fire Pass, The Empire claims the town to be under its sovereignty. However, the population vehemently reject this claim, and the Imperial government seems to exercise little authority over it.

wiki.title: Akendorf
wiki.description: Akendorf, formally the Friest of Akendrof, is one of the larger towns in the Border Princes, located near the southern entrance of Black Fire Pass, to the west of the Thunder River. The current ruler is Lord Durant, who succeeded Prince Rillian, kin of Prince Artilli Levrellian, another of the rulers of the Border Princes with his capital at Zenres. Though Levrellian never much liked Rillian, he gifted him Akendorf as a favour to their mutual aunt.

properties.name: Vitrolle
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 2e: Lure of the Liche Lord

wiki.title: Vitrolle
wiki.description: The Howling River ’s two major branches (after the two northern flows from the mountains coalesce) flow down channels on either side of a wide, triangular patch of land. At its western tip, where those two channels merge into a single river, stands the town of Vitrolle.

properties.name: Fatanbad
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 2e: Lure of the Liche Lord

properties.name: Mortensholm
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

wiki.title: Mortensholm
wiki.description: Mortensholm is a city-state in the Border Princes near the mountain range of The Vaults. Although the Border Princes are in a permanent state of change, during the last years and decades the colonisation of the area has increased; though far from completely pacified, the wild lands of the Border Princes now boast a handful of thriving city-states. The Free City of Mortensholm is one of these fortified settlements, situated on the road that comes from the Winter's Teeth Pass, once it leaves the mountains.

properties.name: Somjek
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

properties.name: Brasov
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

properties.name: Moslac
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

properties.name: Lakoras
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

wiki.title: Lakoras
wiki.description: Lakoras is a town of the north-eastern Border Princes linked to Tilea by the Old Dwarf Pass, a mountain pass set between the peaks of The Vaults and the Apuccini Mountains. Lying on the River Road, Lakoras occupies a key junction within the trade network that runs through the Kharnos Forest toward the Dwarf hold of Karak Grom, and the city of Thessos in the Border Princes, serving as an inland hub where river traffic and caravan routes intersect. The Kharnos Forest is a region notorious for its haunted reputation and the constant threat of banditry and Orc incursions, where dense woodland and winding valleys make the surrounding roads especially vulnerable to ambush, forcing caravans to proceed with constant caution.

properties.name: Achaes
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 1e: Death's Dark Shadow

wiki.title: Yorckweg
wiki.description: Yorckweg, once known as Elsterholz, is a small settlement in the Border Princes. It was ruled by Albrecht Yorck, a minor Border Prince who controlled the small settlement with a despotic iron fist, holding the population under a reign of terror until his death at the hand of the infamous bounty hunter Brunner.

properties.name: Dortmere
properties.source: Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat (PC Game)

properties.name: Alfori
properties.source: The End Times: The Return of Nagash (Novel) by Josh Reynolds

wiki.title: Alfori
wiki.description: Alfori is an indipendent demesne of the Border Princes ruled by the duke, Farnio Forzini. Renown for its fine millet, it is its prime export, as with so many of the tiny mountain realms of the Border Princes.

properties.name: Alvazzo
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4e: Up in Arms

wiki.title: Alvazzo
wiki.description: Alvazzo is either a Tilean or Border Princes fort located near the Apuccini Mountains foothills that was once ruled by the Duke of Alvazzo.

wiki.title: Bechtersmoln
wiki.description: Bechtersmoln is a dreary walled village in the Border Princes, located on the road to the western town of Grunnenburg. The village is characterized by its gloomy atmosphere and sparse population. It consists of a few dilapidated buildings, with most structures showing signs of decay and neglect.

wiki.title: Grunnenburg
wiki.description: Grunnenburg is a dreary little town raised on ancient ruins by Baron Harkov in the Border Princes a century ago. The current baron is the grandson of that brave pioneer. He's a sad-looking, fishy man whose face bears an expression of resentment at his ancestor’s boldness.

properties.name: Castello del Dimenticato
properties.source: Angelika Fleischer - Honour of the Grave (Novel) by Robin D.Laws

wiki.title: Castello del Dimenticato
wiki.description: Castello del Dimenticato is a walled town in the middle of nowhere in the Border Princes. It is populated by people for whom anything was a step up in life. It is located just inside the gullet of Black Fire Pass, south of Averland.

properties.name: Catinari
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 3e: Black Fire Pass

wiki.title: Catinari
wiki.description: Catinari was a small, ethnically Tilean principality in the Border Princes ruled by Prince Catinari I, who now leads a group of refugees after their realm was overrun by Orcs.

properties.name: Filln's Rest
properties.source: Warhammer: Shadow of the Horned Rat (PC Game)

properties.name: Greymere
properties.source: Brunner the Bounty Hunter (Omnibus Novel) by C. L. Werner

wiki.title: Greymere
wiki.description: Greymere is a fortified city in the Border Princes, and is ruled by Prince Waldemar. The city has a pit for gladiator fights and a single inn, where Brunner the Bounty Hunter once stayed and had to defend himself against the attempted assassination of Drexler and Savio.

properties.name: Lissa
properties.source: Tamurkhan: The Throne of Chaos (8th Edition)

wiki.title: Lissa
wiki.description: Lissa is a territory located between the Black Peninsula and the contested territories of the Barony of Mirasino in the Border Princes. Its name probably originates from the famed heroine Monna Lissa Galeazzo, who in the past has fought valiantly at the siege of Monte Castello against a tide of Greenskins. Its territories are reachable from Tilea through the Lissa Road.

properties.name: Mirasino
properties.source: Tamurkhan: The Throne of Chaos (8th Edition)

wiki.title: Mirasino
wiki.description: Mirasino is a barony and a contested territory located between Lissa and the Principality of Scarosio on the eastern side of the Tilean peninsula in the Border Princes. Its territories include the Dread Hall and Lament located beyond the river Tana Dante, in Lost Khypnia territory. Mirasino is reachable from Tilea through the Apuccini Mountains from the Trantio Road and the Pavona Road.

properties.name: Scarosio
properties.source: Tamurkhan: The Throne of Chaos (8th Edition)

wiki.title: Scarosio
wiki.description: The Principality of Scarosio is a domain in the Border Princes. Its mercenaries have taken part in the siege of the fortress of Kerbrus the Reaver, where after cannoning the gate with a gunnery train, captain Santos decide to employ the Bright Wizard, Albrecht, to summon an Incarnate Elemental of Fire, which led to victory his army.

wiki.title: Organza Nova
wiki.description: Organza Nova is a principality in the Border Princes ruled by Prince Giovanni Badrinattl. Prince Badrinatti carried the banners of the goddess Verena and her daughter Myrmidia, the goddess of war, throughout a protracted border war with the neighbouring principality of Rif al Sakhr, and was able to hoist them from the battlements of the enemy capital after a successful siege. The name of the city means "New Organza", and it's probably named after Organza, a Tilean city near Pavona.

wiki.title: Sonnental
wiki.description: In the northern Border Princes, in the shadow of the haunted Geistenmund Hills, lies the town of Sonnental. Originally founded by Imperial exiles, Sonnental now has a darker heritage. The town's walls are guarded by the Undead, not only to keep the marauders and Greenskins out, but also to keep the inhabitants in.

wiki.title: Tinea
wiki.description: Tinea was an ancient Tilean city famed for its healers in the western Border Princes, not far from the border of present-day Tilea. It was there, millennia ago, that Myrmidia, the goddess of war and strategy, in her mortal form, discovered ancient texts penned by the High Elf scholar Gaelen. She was intrigued by the complexity of the anatomical drawings found within, so passed them on to the cult of her mother, Verena, the goddess of law and wisdom.

properties.name: Tengey
properties.source: Night of the Daemon (Novel) by Aaron Rosenberg

properties.name: Vassengast
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 4e: Tribes and Tribulations

properties.name: Verldorf
properties.source: Angelika Fleischer - Head Hunting (Novel) by Robin D.Laws

properties.name: Vossheim
properties.source: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay 3e: Black Fire Pass

properties.name: Brezano
properties.source: Brunner the Bounty Hunter (Novel) by C.L. Werner

wiki.title: Brezano
wiki.description: Brezano is a town in the Border Princes near Yorckweg, another settlement a few days' distance away. As a town, Brezano is much larger than Yorckweg, and a typical inhabitant of the region would be amazed at the activity in the streets. Carts and beasts of burden lumber along the way, carrying sacks of meal, bolts of cloth, casks of wine and other goods uncommon in the harsh villages of the Border Princes.

wiki.title: Lichtenberg
wiki.description: Lichtenberg, also called Lichtenholm, was an Imperial province founded by Emperor Sigismund II as part of a southern expansion of the Empire during his reign sometime between 479 and 505 IC. It was established in the region of the Border Princes, a wild and tribal region located to the south of the Empire. Sigismund II's campaign in this area aimed to bring the unruly lands under Imperial control and secure the Empire's southeastern borders.

properties.name: Maltane
properties.source: Gilead (Part 1) - Gilead's Blood (Novel) by Dan Abnett and Nik Vincent

wiki.title: Maltane
wiki.description: Maltane is a small settlement in the Border Princes. Beyond the village, the woods are thick and rise to southern hills with jagged crests. To the west and east lies more woodland, following the bowl of the valley.

wiki.title: Schipdorf
wiki.description: Schipdorf was the site of a siege in which Maximilian Damark led the Miragliano Marskmen into the breach for first, and the siege thus brought to a successful conclusion. The captain was just slightly injured.

wiki.title: Vlent
wiki.description: The city of Vlent in the Empire was the site of a great battle in which the mercenary band of the Marksmen of Miragliano won, gaining great fame.
